follows.empty.disabled: Nothing followed on this device. Press “follow” on a train in the board to turn on notifications.
follows.empty.enabled: You are not following any train. Press “follow” on a train in the board.
follows.err.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Enable them in the browser settings.
follows.err.load: Could not load the followed trains.
follows.err.no_permission: Without notification permission I cannot follow trains.
follows.err.no_response: The server did not respond. Try again.
follows.err.not_enabled: Notifications are not yet enabled on the server.
follows.reason.ios: On iPhone, first add the app to the home screen.
follows.reason.past: The train belongs to a past day; only trains of today or later can be followed.
follows.reason.unsupported: Notifications need a secure connection (HTTPS) and a compatible browser.
follows.status.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site in the browser settings.
follows.status.off: Off. They turn on automatically when you follow your first train.
follows.status.on: On. You get notifications for the followed trains.
follows.status.unavailable: Notifications are not available on this device.
follows.sub: You get a notification when a followed train's delay or platform changes, or when it leaves the board.
follows.title: Followed trains
follows.toast.disabled: Notifications off. The follows were deleted.
follows.toast.followed: You are following train {no}. You get a notification on changes.
follows.toast.unfollowed: You are no longer following train {no}.
follows.unread_title: The delay cell could not be read from the CFR board
history.chart.desc: Horizontal axis: time the board was read. Vertical axis: delay shown, in minutes. {what}.
history.chart.heading: Delay read over time
history.chart.none: No delay reading for this journey — we do not draw a chart from unread values.
history.chart.note: (dots); between readings the line keeps the last value read
history.chart.note_axes: . X axis: reading time (Romanian time). Y axis: delay, in minutes.
history.chart.note_gone: ; the vertical marker = disappearance from the board
history.chart.title: Observed delay over time
history.day_hint: Leave the day empty for all days.
history.delay.max_title: Largest delay read on the board
history.delay.unread_title: The delay was not read from the CFR board for this journey
history.empty.filters: No trains observed for these filters.
history.empty.train_filters: No observed journeys of this train for these filters.
history.empty.train_none: Train {no} has not been observed on the board.
history.err.future: The day cannot be in the future — history starts with what has already been observed.
history.err.no_response: The server did not respond. Try again in a moment.
history.err.offline: You are offline — history needs a connection.
history.err.rate_limit: Too many requests — wait a few seconds.
history.err.time_order: The “from” time is after the “to” time.
history.err.train_digits: The train number has digits only (max 6).
history.events_none: No events recorded for this journey.
history.group.caption: Journeys of {day}
history.res.note: Service date = the day of the scheduled time (a 00:05 train read on the board at 23:58 belongs to the next day). The delay is the one READ on the București Nord board, not the real arrival/departure time. “Confirmed” = the disappearance from the board was observed after the estimated time, and the delay was read at most {gap} min before.
history.row.low_quality_title: Read during the low-quality period (initial beta) — not included in the summary
history.sub: Everything the CFR board showed, from all days (newest first): scheduled times, delays read and platforms. Pick a day, a train, a station or a time range to narrow the list.
history.sum.low_quality_note: {count} from the low-quality period (initial beta) appear in the list but are not included in the summary.
history.sum.none_read: no delay read for finished journeys (unknown, not 0).
history.sum.note: The delay is the one READ on the București Nord board. Mean, median and max use only finished journeys with the delay read ({mode}); unknown ones are left out and are not 0.
history.title: History
peron.label: Estimated platform {platform}, confidence {pct}% of {n} observations; {notice}
peron.name: est. platform
peron.note_backtest: In the history backtest, the estimates shown (at least 5 observations, the same platform in at least 80% of them) were correct in ~{pct}% of cases ({n} cases). It is not a guarantee.
peron.notice: estimate from observed history, not official CFR information
